messages:
nina: spotted two micro-spikes of late events in eu-west last night (~1.2k total). looks like uploader backoff cluster. thinking: selective window reprocess instead of full-day backfill to avoid wasting slots
kai: sounds good. exact windows?
nina: 2026-03-22T02:14-02:22Z and 02:47-02:55Z. small cohorts only.
rachel: agree on targeted runs. question: how do we choose routing? Dedicated preferred for efficiency, but many tenants don't have reserved capacity. propose: routing precedence = tenant_reserved -> tenant_burst_allowed -> shared:rate(60r/s). document in console.
frank: add a per-tenant monthly burst allowance (default 0) to avoid surprise bills. sales can enable for enterprise accounts.
ops-bot: JOB_PENDING: dry-run created (id: eu-micro-9001)
kai: dry-run plan: sample 0.5% of keys, estimate delta and cost, show a projected full-delta and cost in the console. CLI prototype:
```
recompute run --region eu-west --window "2026-03-22T02:14Z/2026-03-22T02:22Z" --sample 0.005 --prefer dedicated --dry-run
```
rachel: console UX: add a compact dry-run card showing sample_delta, projected_delta, estimated_cost, chosen_pool, fallback. include an "apply" button and an "operator-override" toggle only visible to SRE/Product Ops.
nina: safety thresholds: auto-apply if projected_delta <= 0.02% and cost <= $5; require manual approval if projected_delta in (0.02%, 0.5%); block and create incident if >0.5%.
frank: add a preflight sketch check: take a tiny sketch of pre/post on an independent sample to detect catastrophic diffs before kicking full recompute. if sketch_diff > 0.4% abort.
ops-bot: ALERT_SUGGESTION: post to #incidents if recompute_delta > 0.5% or job fails 3x.
kai: implementation tasks: (1) routing precedence + shared throttle config (2) console dry-run card + apply/override flows (3) burst allowance per-tenant + monthly cap (4) preflight sketch check and post-run snapshot diff (5) ops-bot alert rule
rachel: also include a tiny cost-breakdown (est. tokens, batching factor) on the dry-run card so owners can see tradeoffs before accepting.
nina: i'll run the dry-run at 05:10 UTC and post results. tagging @eng-sre for monitoring.
ops-bot: REMINDER: oncall (eng-sre) notified for eu-micro-9001 at 05:10 UTC
frank: please capture slot acquisition latency and pack efficiency metrics during the run so we can tune concurrency defaults.
kai: thanks — we'll follow up with a short post-run summary and whether the auto-apply rules would have triggered.
